nom: Clinique Smart Clinical Repair AM/PM Retinoid Balm

segments.oily: No reviewer identifies as having oily skin firsthand, but several caution that the balm's heavier, balm-like texture may feel greasy or be too much for oily skin and should be used sparingly in that case.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including a man with very dry skin and others with chronically dry under-eye areas, report the balm absorbs well, hydrates, and helps their dry skin rather than drying it out further.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no burning, stinging, or irritation even directly under the eyes, though one reviewer who describes her skin as sensitive also reports new redness and tenderness after use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s through late 70s most often report visibly softer fine lines, crow's feet, or neck lines within a few weeks to a couple of months, with effects described as more noticeable on shallow lines than on deep-set wrinkles.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly softer fine lines, crow's feet, or neck lines within two to six weeks of regular use, with some describing dramatic change around the eyes, mouth, or neck after a few months; several others, including some who tried it for only a few weeks, report no noticeable difference, and one reviewer cautions that retinoid balms of this kind can take up to six months to show results.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the balm as strongly moisturizing and effective at locking in moisture around the eyes and lips, including for chronically dry under-eye skin, and a few note it dries out the face less than applying a retinol cream all over.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no burning, stinging, or irritation, even directly under the eyes; two reviewers, however, describe eye burning or redness and tenderness after application, one of whom says she does not otherwise have sensitive skin.
concerns.blemishes: Only one reviewer addresses breakouts directly, reporting the balm did not trigger any while using it nightly.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers, none of whom identify as oily-skinned themselves, describe the balm as heavy or greasy and suggest oily skin should use it sparingly; others report it is not oily or thick and absorbs without interfering with makeup.

aspects.libelle: Texture can feel greasy or waxy

extraits.texte: I love Clinique but, unfortunately this wasn't for me. I'm sure it works wonderful for some people but this made my eyes burn horribly. Not the outside corners of my eyes where I applied it, my actual eyes. I made sure not to put it too close to my eyes when testing this out. It felt fine at first then about 5 minutes later I noticed my eyes stinging. I don't have sensitive skin or eyes so this was unexpected. I hope this works for others but, I had to discontinue using the product.

I received this product for free from influenster and Clinique in exchange for my honest review. So I'm 27, with very sensitive skin. This retinol balm stick did not irritate my skin or cause any burning by my eyes when I applied under my eyes. So that's a huge plus. This absorbed well for me, it stays balmy for a while but my skin soaks it in which I really like. As far as effectiveness.. I haven't noticed any difference, but it's possible I haven't used it long enough. I use tretinoin once a week so I use this twice a week as well. This also has no scent at all.

This Clinique AM/PM Retinoid Balm is really easy to use. The stick is convenient so you don't have to get it on your hands. I've used it a couple days a week for a couple weeks now on my forehead & crows feet. I don't notice much difference in my wrinkles. Around my eyes is really tender and red now. I have sensitive skin. There is no smell. It's tacky when you put it on but it absorbs.

extraits.titre: Wow - great addition to my routine
extraits.texte: I was skeptical at first. But after 6 weeks, I see a difference. I am a man with sensitive and very dry skin. I see a difference in the crow's feet and wrinkles around my eyes and temples. People have noticed that I look younger and my skin looks smoother. It is part of an overall routine with the right cleanser, serum, and moisturizer - and now this addition has made a visible difference. It is thick and stays on thick - so my dry skin quickly absorbs it. Men with oily skin may have a harder time with this one.

Wonderful product, especially for maturing dry eyes! I've had dry eyes my entire life, but really struggle now at the age of 62. This balm is so effective at locking in moisture & with little product required. Also, it has retinol! The best eye product Clinique has on the market for dry aging eyes!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review from influenster. I really liked that it was super easy to use and mess free. The applicator looks like a lipstick and it's very easy and comfortable to hold. It's easy to control the amount of product and where I'm applying it. I mostly use it at night and I wear sunscreen as recommended. It did not irritate my skin or bring on any breakouts. I have been using it for about 3 weeks and I can definitely notice a difference. Definitely would recommend!
